text: 鑫宏业公告，公司拟向不特定对象发行可转换公司债券，募集资金总额不超过11亿元（含发行费用），扣除发行费用后用于轻量化金属复合导体线缆研发及产业化项目等项目及补充流动资金。本次发行尚待公司股东会审议及深圳证券交易所发行上市审核并报经中国证监会注册。
text_en: Xinhongye announced that the company plans to issue convertible corporate bonds to unspecified investors, raising no more than RMB 1.1 billion (including issuance costs), with proceeds used after deducting issuance costs for projects such as R&D and industrialization of lightweight metal composite conductor cables and working capital. The issuance is still subject to shareholder meeting approval and review by the Shenzhen Stock Exchange for listing and registration with the CSRC.
